info.title: Switch Hero
info.author: Rodrigo Ferreira
info.description: A rhythm game for Nintendo Switch
info.details:
Switch Hero is a five-lane rhythm game for Nintendo Switch, inspired by classic guitar rhythm games. Play with Joy-Con, a Pro Controller or a compatible Wii guitar controller.

It reads Clone Hero-style song folders, so you can bring your existing songs and charts to the Switch. A demo song is included. Add more songs to /switch/switch-hero/songs.

Features:
  - Joy-Con, Pro Controller and Wii guitar support
  - Clone Hero-compatible custom songs and charts
  - Multiple difficulty levels, solos and star power
  - Split-screen multiplayer for 2 to 4 players (docked)
  - Practice mode
  - 13 highways and 24 note color palettes
  - Score tracking and results screen
  - English, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish
